fields.headline: Buys Cisco phone licenses from CDW-G for up to $648,960 through an existing contract, 2020-2025
fields.summary: CDW-Government LLC would provide Cisco Flex licenses for virtual phone systems so school sites and teachers can communicate with families. The district is buying through an existing contract (the CalSAVE Stretch Agreement) instead of running its own bid. The five-year term runs December 15, 2020 through December 14, 2025, at up to $648,960.00. The official text also prints an earlier figure of $649,532.00, which the attached memo shows was replaced.

20-2449.note: Amount corrected from $649,532 to $648,960, per the attached memo and CDW order form.
20-2449.sourceIssue: The official text prints two not-to-exceed amounts, $649,532.00 and a misformatted $648.960.00; the attached memo and vendor order form show the intended amount is $648,960.00.
